note: Campground at the Harold Warp Pioneer Village museum in Minden, just off US 6/34. Two areas: the original South campground (grass and gravel, mature shade, partial and full hookups) and the North expansion opened in 2026 (25 crushed-rock full-hookup sites, with its own bathhouse and laundry). Camping includes re-entry to the museum the next day on the same admission. --Claude
summary: Amenities page + ResNexus engine read today: primitive to 30/50 A, sites up to 50 ft, online booking; the engine lists 25 North full-hookup sites at $40 (Nov 2026). flags: DROP CANDIDATE (RV Life rule): RV Life averages 7.76/10 over 57 ratings, under the 8.0 line with 25+ ratings. Google is 4.1 from 132 (passes 4.0). The showers and restrooms had not been cleaned since the previous year. Showers were dirty with long strands of hair'; 10/2025 Fifth Wheel, $33: 'Very nice level full hookup and partial hookup sites with bathhouse. Needs some tlc but very nice otherwise'; 6/2026 Travel Trailer, $30: 'Very nice park. They added new spots with more 50 amp service'; 9/2026 Fifth Wheel, $40, site 12N: 'In the new (North) campground, there are 25 sites, all full hookup, with 14 being pull through and 11 back-in. The sites are fairly level crushed rock'. I read it as borderline: it fails the RV Life average, the price is fine, and the new North loop is reviewed well. AWH to decide.
